//: Claude Code settings for the Azure AI Gateway.
Place at ONE of (highest precedence first):
Use managed-settings.json for a fleet rollout: users cannot override it.
Use ~/.claude/settings.json to pilot with a single user first.
NOTE: apiKeyHelper supplies the Entra bearer token, so do NOT also set
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN here - a static value would
shadow the refreshing helper and start failing when the token expires.
//_otelHeadersHelper: Supplies the Entra bearer token for telemetry export, so the OTLP API needs
no APIM subscription key distributed to developer machines.
Different output contract from apiKeyHelper: this emits a JSON OBJECT of
headers, not a bare token. Re-run every 29 minutes.
Drop this key if your OTLP API uses a subscription key instead; in that case
set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS and treat the key as a secret.

//_otlp_endpoint: Points at the OTLP ingestion API on APIM, which forwards to Application
Insights. There is no collector to deploy.
This is the ROOT, ending at /otlp. Claude Code appends /v1/metrics and
/v1/logs itself - adding a suffix here yields /v1/metrics/v1/metrics and
Do NOT append a port either. ':443' lands after the PATH, not the host,
so APIM receives '/otlp:443/v1/metrics' as a literal segment and answers
404 Resource not found. Verified against a live gateway.
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL has NO default in Claude Code. Removing it
does not fall back to a sensible value - telemetry just stops, silently.
It must be http/protobuf: the ingestion API rejects application/json with
415 UnsupportedMediaType, so http/json drops every export.
//_tracing: Traces are beta and off by default. To enable, add:
//_prompt_logging: OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS sends prompt text to Azure.
OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES INHERITS that value when unset - enabling
prompts also enables responses unless you explicitly set it to "0".
Leave all three off unless legal/privacy has explicitly approved them.
